UAE-based Jampur Group has been selected to manage and modernize Mozambique’s Beluluane Solar Panel Factory, which suspended production around 2022 due to technological limitations and market competition. The initiative aims to revive domestic solar panel manufacturing, improve competitiveness and create local employment opportunities.

summary:

title: Vietnam orders provinces to introduce rooftop solar incentives by December 2026
summary:
Vietnam has instructed provincial and municipal authorities to introduce support policies for residential rooftop solar installations by the end of December 2026, as part of efforts to secure electricity supplies between 2027 and 2030. The government is also pushing for faster deployment of battery energy storage systems, particularly in northern Vietnam.

title: Couple travels through 10 African countries in solar-powered motorhome with battery storage
summary:
A Brazilian couple traveled through 10 African countries in a motorhome equipped with rooftop solar panels, 15.36 kWh of lithium battery storage, and alternator charging. The system powers household appliances and satellite internet, enabling off-grid travel with minimal reliance on external electricity connections.
